# Alert usage

Alerts are GitHub-specific syntax and must not be stripped or converted.

> [!NOTE]
> The metadata for tokens is currently in public preview and subject to change.

> [!TIP]
> Use the theme inspector to preview token changes live.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Themes must be registered before widgets use them.

> [!WARNING]
> Calling `destroy()` twice releases the same listeners twice.

> [!CAUTION]
> Do not run the cleanup script outside a staging copy of the database.

## Context

These alerts emphasize information within the article. They should stay exactly as written, with correct type keywords and the `> ` continuation lines intact.
